caption:
Swipe through → 5 free AI tools that watch your competitors so you don't have to. 🔍

1) Perplexity AI: type a rival's name, get a full research report in 60 seconds,
2) Claude vision: screenshot their homepage and get a weakness breakdown in 30 seconds,
3) ChatGPT: browse their Google reviews and surface every complaint they never fix,
4) Google Alerts plus Claude: paste a free weekly digest into Claude for a rival strategy briefing,
5) Wayback Machine plus Claude: upload an old screenshot of their site alongside today's version and find what they quietly abandoned.

A Berlin artist just proved the AI embedded in public cameras is free online. Your competitors' pricing, reviews, and old strategy are all sitting in public data. These five tools read all of it. Most owners don't know they exist.

Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.

Sources: Perplexity AI, Anthropic, OpenAI, archive.org, Simon Weckert AI camera pattern research
